subgoals: Draw the tangent at the current guess

visual.title: Follow the tangent to the axis
visual.caption: Newton evaluates the function and its derivative at the current guess, draws the tangent, and takes its x-intercept as the next guess. The markers and tangent lines are the actual iterates, not an illustration of them.

predict.question: For x³ − x − 1, Newton starts at x = 1. What is the next guess?
predict.explain: f(1) = −1 and f′(1) = 2. The tangent intercept is x − f(x)/f′(x) = 1 − (−1)/2 = 1.5.
